bugs.name: Followers tab list does not update after Follow/Unfollow — count and list disagree until reload
bugs.summary: Follow/Unfollow updates only the 'N Followers' counter in the sidebar; the followers list is left as it was. After Follow the counter says '1 Followers' while the list is empty (screenshot after follow), after Unfollow the counter says '0 Followers' while one follower card is still displayed (screenshot after unfollow). Only a full page reload brings the list in line with the count. (on /alex?tab=followers)
bugs.expected: The followers list on the Followers tab is re-rendered together with the count: after Follow the new follower's card appears immediately, after Unfollow it disappears immediately, so the list and the 'N Followers' counter always agree.
bugs.actual: Follow/Unfollow updates only the 'N Followers' counter in the sidebar; the followers list is left as it was. After Follow the counter says '1 Followers' while the list is empty (screenshot after follow), after Unfollow the counter says '0 Followers' while one follower card is still displayed (screenshot after unfollow). Only a full page reload brings the list in line with the count.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval (username eval / password momentic-eval-1) and open https://5503-io7gkkxhkz5bckp0f49nq.e2b.app/alex?tab=followers (alex has 0 followers at this point).
Click the 'Follow' button under alex's profile card in the left sidebar.
The page re-renders: the sidebar counter now reads '1 Followers', but the followers list area to the right of the tab bar stays completely empty.
Reload the page (F5): eval's card now appears in the followers list, so the data exists.
With the list showing eval, click 'Unfollow': the counter goes back to '0 Followers' but eval's card is still listed in the followers area.

bugs.name: Repository search treats SQL wildcards as wildcards: "%" and "_" match every repo
bugs.summary: The query '%' returns the repository 'harbor-handbook' (and '_' returns every repo as well). The characters are sent as SQL LIKE wildcards instead of literal text, so a search that should match nothing lists repositories whose names/descriptions do not contain the searched text at all. URL after searching: /eval?tab=repositories&q=%25&sort=recentupdate. (on /eval?tab=repositories)
bugs.expected: Searching for '%' (or '_') should find no repository, because no repository name or description contains that character; the page should show 'No matching results found.' like it does for any other non-matching query (e.g. 'zzz-no-match').
bugs.actual: The query '%' returns the repository 'harbor-handbook' (and '_' returns every repo as well). The characters are sent as SQL LIKE wildcards instead of literal text, so a search that should match nothing lists repositories whose names/descriptions do not contain the searched text at all. URL after searching: /eval?tab=repositories&q=%25&sort=recentupdate.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval and open https://5503-io7gkkxhkz5bckp0f49nq.e2b.app/eval?tab=repositories
In the 'Search repos...' box type a single '%' and press Enter (or click the magnifier)
Note the result list
Repeat with a single '_' as the query

bugs.name: A user who is blocked by someone can still follow them
bugs.summary: The Follow button works: after the click the profile shows "1 Followers" and the button turns into "Unfollow", and the state survives a reload, so eval's account is now following alex even though alex has eval blocked. Nothing on the page says the follow was refused. The block therefore does not prevent the blocked user from following the blocker, contrary to the panel's own list of what blocking prevents. (on /alex)
bugs.expected: Because alex blocks eval, eval must not be able to follow alex: the follow is refused with a message (as the Block panel states, blocking prevents "following your account"), and eval does not appear in alex's followers.
bugs.actual: The Follow button works: after the click the profile shows "1 Followers" and the button turns into "Unfollow", and the state survives a reload, so eval's account is now following alex even though alex has eval blocked. Nothing on the page says the follow was refused. The block therefore does not prevent the blocked user from following the blocker, contrary to the panel's own list of what blocking prevents.
reproSteps: Sign in as alex / momentic-contributor-1 and open https://5503-io7gkkxhkz5bckp0f49nq.e2b.app/user/settings/blocked_users — eval is in alex's 'Blocked users' list (the panel states blocking prevents 'following your account')
Sign out, sign in as eval / momentic-eval-1 and open https://5503-io7gkkxhkz5bckp0f49nq.e2b.app/alex
